vote(uint256,(uint120,uint8)[],uint256,u.details: - The function checks that the validator has not already voted in the current round. - If the voter is new (first round), their vote will not be recorded until their next submission. - If the number of reports does not match the expected symbols, the vote will be discarded. - If the last round's commitment does not match the current commitment, the vote is invalidated.
